title: No fixed pay: a monthly line is spread by day, rounded down, the rest of each month's share on its last day (M10); a weekly line gets a seventh a day, rounded down, the rest on the seventh day counted from the day the line started (M9, N4, AS9)
story: Bea has no fixed pay day. Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000 and a commute e-wallet 100,000. Food is 31,000 a month, on the bank. Transport is 7,500 a week, on the e-wallet, a line she added on Sun 10 Jan (its `from`), so its weeks run Sunday to Saturday. Nothing is expected in, so each account only goes down by its planned spending, a day at a time. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 300,000 (bank today) - 15,285 (Food 16 to 30 Jan: 15 days at 1,019, which is 31,000 x 12 / 365 rounded down) - 1,024 (Food 31 Jan, the month's last day: January's share 31,000 x 12 x 31 / 365 is 31,594 rounded down, less 30 days at 1,019) - 28,536 (Food in February: its share 31,000 x 12 x 28 / 365 rounded down, 27 days at 1,019 and 1,023 on 28 Feb) - 1,019 (Food 1 Mar, the last day of the 45-day look ahead) = 254,136
asks.note: Spread with the remainder carried day to day (the plain form) the 45 days take 45,863.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 100,000 (e-wallet today) - 48,195 (Transport 16 Jan to 1 Mar: 45 days at 1,071, a seventh of 7,500 rounded down) - 21 (the remainder, 3 more on the seventh day of each week counted from the line's start on Sun 10 Jan: 16, 23 and 30 Jan, 6, 13, 20 and 27 Feb) = 51,784
asks.note: Weeks counted from the ask day instead would put only 6 week ends in the 45 days: 51,787.
